question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who looks at the bright side of things/situations
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Optimist"** means someone who tends to look on the more favorable side of events or conditions and expects the most favorable outcome. (आशावादी)

 
 
• **Example: **Even during the toughest times, she remained an optimist, always believing that things would get better.
 
 
 
• **"Optimist"** refers to a person who habitually expects good things to happen and sees the positive side of life. (आशावादी)
 
 
• **Example: **John is an optimist who always encourages his friends to see the silver lining in every situation.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Saint **(संत): A person acknowledged as holy or virtuous and regarded in Christian faith as being in heaven after death.

 
 
• **Example:** Mother Teresa is regarded as a saint for her selfless service to humanity.
 
 
 
• **Pessimist **(निराशावादी): A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen.
 
 
• **Example: **Unlike his optimistic friend, Mark is a pessimist who always expects things to go wrong.
 
 
 
• **Scientist** (वैज्ञानिक): A person who conducts scientific research to advance knowledge in an area of interest.
 
 
• **Example:** Marie Curie was a pioneering scientist known for her work on radioactivity.
